name: Que Tra Bong
summary: Quế Trà Bồng is the cinnamon Vietnam Airlines says holds a geographical indication, grown in Trà Bồng on more than 1,700 hectares. The provincial introduction calls the same bark fragrant and warm and prints no area and no price.
taste: Vietnam Airlines says the bark is thick and dark, high in oil, warmly fragrant, and mildly hot. The provincial introduction says thơm nồng.
howToEat: Vietnam Airlines lists quills, powder, chips, cinnamon tea, and craft objects, and calls it a spice, a medicinal bark, and a gift. It does not print a drink recipe.
No hour was printed. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: Trà Bồng. Not the city center. Vietnam Airlines names no shop.
priceBand: Vietnam Airlines prints 55,000 VND a kilogram for dried bark, 150,000 VND for 500 g of powder, and 200,000 VND for 10 ml of oil. The provincial introduction printed no price.
seoTitle: Que Tra Bong — Tra Bong cinnamon
seoDescription: Quế Trà Bồng, more than 1,700 hectares in Vietnam Airlines. Dried bark is 55,000 VND a kilogram on that article. The hour is Check on arrival.
